data.name: Ameya
data.gender_notes: Ameya is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ameya means free from illusion or obstacle. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ameya', which means 'inexhaustible' or 'limitless'. In Hindu mythology, Ameya is the name of a god who removes obstacles and protects from danger. The name Ameya carries the meaning “Free from illusion” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ameya usually hope their child will grow to embody free from illusion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ameya belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Free from illusion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ameya total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ameya holds significant cultural importance in Hinduism as it represents a name that is free from all obstacles and illusions. In Hindu mythology, it is associated with the god Ganesha, who is believed to remove all obstacles and promote prosperity and success. The name is also attributed to other Hindu deities and is believed to bring good fortune, wisdom, intelligence, and success in all aspects of life.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ameya signifies a deep and profound connection with the divine. It represents a name that is beyond the physical world and its limitations, and is synonymous with the notion of being free from the illusions that bind us to the material world. The name Ameya is believed to awaken the inner wisdom and intelligence, leading to a deeper understanding of the true nature of the self and the universe. It is said that those named Ameya are blessed with the ability to overcome obstacles and challenges in life with grace and inner peace, making their spiritual journey a fulfilling and enlightening one.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ameya signifies 'boundless', symbolizing the limitless potential for growth and self-realization in one's spiritual journey. The name's syllables 'A' and 'M' represent the divine aspects of the cosmic consciousness, guiding one towards wisdom and truth.
